purpose: Per-family coverage of the compiled first-party artifacts, measured twice: against the UNION of the three (is any tenant able to reach this family) and against each artifact separately (is THIS tenant able to). Successor to the variant-parity / mirror-parity pair F-54 retired.
direction: Exact pins on the READ counters: uncovered may only fall, covered may only rise, and either way a move is red with the instruction to re-pin in the same commit. The family POPULATION is not a counter — familyRoster is a named set, like unreachableFamilies, because a count is blind to a rename. A family leaves only through retiredFamilies, whose value is the written reason; an empty reason is refused. The per-artifact counters exist because the union cannot see a channel leaving ONE artifact while the other two still declare it.
perArtifactNote: coveredPerVertical is the per-artifact half of the same measurement; covered above is the union and coveredEveryVertical the intersection. Measured 2026-09-11: 402 of the union-covered reads rest on a channel at least one vertical does not declare.
